'''Krishna Shyamacharya Amur''' (born 1931) was a professor emeritus of mathematics in [[differential geometry]]<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.amurs.org/ksamur_pubs |title=- Amur's publications |access-date=11 April 2009 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20120717083036/http://www.amurs.org/ksamur_pubs |archive-date=17 July 2012 |url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>[http://genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=107986 - Mathematics Genealogy Project]</ref> was head of the department of mathematics, [[Karnatak University]], Dharwar.<ref>[http://www.kud.ernet.in/PG_Deparments/Science_Departments/Mathamatics/maths.htm Karnataka University] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080613160628/http://www.kud.ernet.in/PG_Deparments/Science_Departments/Mathamatics/maths.htm |date=2008-06-13}}</ref> 
Amur was vice-president of Karnatak Education Board, Dharwar.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://keboarddharwad.com/index_files/Page400.htm |title=- KE Board, Dharwar |access-date=11 April 2009 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110713141649/http://keboarddharwad.com/index_files/Page400.htm |archive-date=13 July 2011 |url-status=dead}}</ref> and a brother of [[G. S. Amur]].

Born and raised in Suranagi village of [[Haveri]] taluka, he earned a M.Sc. and a Ph.D. (1964) in mathematics from the Karnataka University, Dharwar. 

Amur was a postdoctoral fellow at the department of mathematics, [[University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill]], from 1967 to 1968 and again in 1984, he went to the USA on a fellowship program for a year.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.amurs.org/kn_ksamur |title=- Visit to US, a record in Kannada language |access-date=27 April 2009 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20120719032032/http://www.amurs.org/kn_ksamur |archive-date=19 July 2012 |url-status=dead}}</ref> He was also acting registrar of the Karnatak University, Dharwar from 1978-80.

Amur was the President of Sri Aurobindo society,<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.amurs.org/kn_ksamur |title=- President of Sri Aurobindo, Karnataka state |access-date=27 April 2009 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20120719032032/http://www.amurs.org/kn_ksamur |archive-date=19 July 2012 |url-status=dead}}</ref> Karnataka State.
